newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian rollover T-bill issue fully-subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romanian rollover T-bill issue fully-subscribed.

text.p: A 503.28 billion lei ($88.3 million) issue of Romania's Finance Ministry rollover treasury bills was fully subscribed, the central bank said on Monday.
It said the T-bills, put on offer in a public subscription last Friday, were bought by 15 local commercial banks and their corporate clients.
The T-bills, maturing on May 15, offer an annual yield calculated as an average of the weekly auctioned credit rates during their life period.
Last week, the one-week auctioned credit rate was 70.05 percent, up from a previous 65 percent.
-- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 ($ = 5700 Romanian Lei)
